There are no default answers and no example output values. Return only a JSON object, without explanations or markdown. Return false only if EVERY registered slot is disclosed and its report interval proves it is NOT below threshold_m. Return unknown for unresolved or unqueried slots unless another disclosed slot already proves the existential proposition. Return conflict only for inconsistent source facts, not ordinary uncertainty. The presence of some evidence does not itself make the proposition true. Use visibility bounds in meters, including open/closed endpoints. Forecast the FUTURE native routine visibility report event defined by target. probability must be a finite JSON number in [0,1], not a boolean or string. Use the common full TAF, frozen research probability with its disclosed calibration period, and any disclosed neighbor report information; you may retain the baseline. TEMPO is not an official event probability. Unresolved past evidence does not force the future probability to 0.5, and known past facts do not determine the future. The past evidence proposition and future target are separate. The output object must contain exactly fact_truth and probability.
